Description:
Inspired by Bennoloth's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21419]Simple Whiskey[/url] mod.

[/b]Create [b]Saké [/b]by placing Koji in a Keg. [b]Takes 11 days.[/b][b]

[/b]++
